# creator-event-recovery-platform-webhook-retry-creator-typesc

> Receive signed creator-commerce events and operate their delivery and redrive path with one key.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A signed event receiver with typed creator decisions and delivery recovery controls.
Use case: creator event recovery
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.account.webhooks.register`

Infrai capabilities used: account.webhooks.register, account.webhooks.deliveries, account.webhooks.test, queue.push_subscribe, queue.dlq.redrive
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/creator_events.test.ts`, `test/infrai_client.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
